name: [WOLF UPDATE 🐺] The Vampire Legends 2
desc:
🩸 Choose from a variety of supernatural species, including vampires, witches, and werewolves, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles

🏫 Explore iconic locations, such as the mysterious town of Moonlight Creek, the prestigious Supernatural Academy or the historic French Quarter of New Orleans

🎨 Play as one of your favourite pre-made characters, or fully customize your own character with a wide range of options

🎮 Available on PC, mobile devices and console!

👍 Next code at 44,000 likes! Click 🔔 Notify to receive an update when the next code drops
